> Guideline 1.2  Provide alternatives for time-based media. Success Criteria:    1.2.6 Sign Language (Prerecorded) General Objective: To verify that pre-recorded video content with audio provides extended audio descriptions when necessary to understand the content. This test case verifies whether a pre-recorded video on the web site provides extended audio descriptions at times necessary to understand the content. Extended audio descriptions provide information about actions, characters, scenes, and on-screen information that cannot be understood from the original audio of the pre-recorded video alone. Expected Result: The pre-recorded video with audio provides extended audio descriptions at times necessary to understand the content. The extended audio descriptions can be activated and provide additional information that is not available in the original audio of the video.

| :---: | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **1** | Identify prerecorded audio content (videos with narration or dialogue) | — | Videos must include sign language interpretation visible on screen or activatable |
| **2** | Verify visibility and size of sign language interpreter | — | Interpreter must be clearly visible, with adequate contrast and sufficient size to distinguish signs |
| **3** | Verify synchronization between audio and sign language | — | Sign interpretation must be synchronized with spoken audio without significant delays |

### Execution Checklist
- [ ] **Step 1:** Identify prerecorded audio content (videos with narration or dialogue) → *Videos must include sign language interpretation visible on screen or activatable*
- [ ] **Step 2:** Verify visibility and size of sign language interpreter → *Interpreter must be clearly visible, with adequate contrast and sufficient size to distinguish signs*
- [ ] **Step 3:** Verify synchronization between audio and sign language → *Sign interpretation must be synchronized with spoken audio without significant delays*
